stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Senator Ellen Nadeer campaigns against Inhumans and S.H.I.E.L.D., and Daisy learns she is hiding her own Inhuman brother. Daisy, Mace and Simmons confront her at her home, where Daisy spots a Watchdogs gun on her bodyguard.
stages.whoA: An anti-Inhuman senator, secretly hiding her own Inhuman brother.
stages.whoB: The Inhuman agent who confronts her at her home.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes, a Peruvian commander and an old friend of Coulson's, comes aboard the Bus with her soldiers. She then seizes the plane to take the 0-8-4 and holds Skye and the team at gunpoint until they take it back.
stages.whoA: A Peruvian commander who hijacks the Bus and holds her at gunpoint.
stages.whoB: One of Coulson's team she holds hostage when she seizes the Bus.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Lucy Bauer, a scientist turned ghost, wants the Darkhold back and hunts her old colleague Eli Morrow. As Daisy, Coulson and May make their way to his prison cell, Lucy traps them and sets the prisoners loose on them.
stages.whoA: A ghost who sets a prison riot on her while hunting the Darkhold.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she traps in a prison riot.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera, a telekinetic Inhuman loyal to Hydra and then to Hive, tries to shoot Daisy as she hacks into Hydra's castle. When the Secret Warriors storm Hydra's base to retake Zephyr One, Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
stages.whoA: Hydra's telekinetic Inhuman, who tries to shoot her and later serves Hive.
stages.whoB: The Inhuman who blasts him across a hangar.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Colonel Victor Ramon of the Colombian police asks S.H.I.E.L.D. for help with his stolen guns, and Daisy meets him in Bogotá. He then kills a suspect and has Bobbi and Hunter held at his station, and Daisy comes to break them out.
stages.whoA: A Colombian police colonel who turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. in Bogotá.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who breaks his prisoners out of his station.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Out of prison, Ramon tries to sell an 0-8-4 weapon to the Watchdogs. Daisy tracks the deal to help Yo-Yo, who wants revenge for her cousin, and blasts Ramon aside before he is killed in the fight.
stages.whoA: The colonel she fights again when he sells a weapon to the Watchdogs.
stages.whoB: Quake, who blasts him aside to help Yo-Yo.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera hijacks Zephyr One and forces it down at a Hydra base, leaving May badly wounded. She later lures him into a room where his powers are useless and beats him hand to hand.
stages.whoA: Hive's telekinetic soldier, who hijacks her plane and loses to her later.
stages.whoB: The agent he nearly kills on Zephyr One, who later beats him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale, General Hale's daughter and Hydra's young enforcer, ambushes May and the team with androids at an aerospace facility. May is there when Ruby takes in the gravitonium and loses control of its power.
stages.whoA: General Hale's daughter, Hydra's young enforcer, who ambushes her team.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she ambushes, who sees her gain her powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Sinara, Kasius's Kree enforcer in the Lighthouse, takes Simmons away while May is helping her. Later May fights her with a Kree battle ax on a bad leg and loses, and Sinara hands her to Kasius to fight in his arena.
stages.whoA: Kasius's Kree enforcer, who beats her and sends her to the arena.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she defeats and hands over to Kasius.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: S.H.I.E.L.D. tries to protect Eli Morrow, but he betrays them to steal power from another dimension. His reactor blast traps Fitz between dimensions with Coulson and Robbie, and Fitz later works out how to stop him.
stages.whoA: Robbie's uncle, whose reactor blast traps him between dimensions.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist caught in his blast who helps stop him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes, a Peruvian commander and an old friend of Coulson's, comes aboard the Bus with her soldiers. She seizes the plane to take the 0-8-4 and holds Fitz and the team captive until they retake it.
stages.whoA: A Peruvian commander who hijacks the Bus and takes the team captive.
stages.whoB: One of Coulson's team she holds captive on the Bus.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jeffrey Mace is the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., and Fitz works in his lab. Fitz upgrades his Patriot suit, and together they force the exploding Inhuman Tucker Shockley off the plane. When Mace later dies in the Framework, Fitz blames himself.
stages.whoA: His Director, whose suit he upgrades and whose death he blames himself for.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. engineer under him who upgrades his Patriot suit.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley, a Watchdog, turns out to be the Inhuman whose explosion killed Senator Nadeer. Fitz and Simmons work this out, help force him off the plane, and later trap his ashes in a device to capture him.
stages.whoA: A Watchdog turned Inhuman bomb, whom he exposes and captures.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who exposes and captures him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Marcus Daniels, an escaped prisoner who absorbs light and energy, hunts the cellist Audrey Nathan. Fitz tries to stop him with bursts of light and then helps set the trap that brings him down.
stages.whoA: An escaped prisoner who feeds on light, hunting Audrey Nathan.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who helps set the trap that stops him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Donnie Gill is a S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy student who nearly freezes to death in an attack, and Simmons and Fitz save his life. It turns out he and his friend staged the attacks to lure them there.
stages.whoA: An Academy student whose life she saves, then finds behind the attacks.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who saves him from freezing to death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hydra brainwashes Donnie, who can now freeze anything he touches. Simmons, undercover in Hydra, is sent to bring him back, and when he realizes she is trying to control him, he tries to kill her.
stages.whoA: A brainwashed Hydra asset she is sent to bring back, who turns on her.
stages.whoB: The scientist he trusts, until he finds her with Hydra.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes, a Peruvian commander and an old friend of Coulson's, comes aboard the Bus with her soldiers. She seizes the plane to take the 0-8-4 and holds Simmons and the team captive until they retake it.
stages.whoA: A Peruvian commander who hijacks the Bus and takes the team captive.
stages.whoB: One of Coulson's team she holds captive on the Bus.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Marcus Daniels, an escaped prisoner who absorbs light and energy, hunts the cellist Audrey Nathan. Simmons and Trip get Audrey away from him, and he knocks them down when the team springs its trap.
stages.whoA: An escaped prisoner who feeds on light, hunting Audrey Nathan.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who gets Audrey away from him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: General Glenn Talbot works with Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. in the fight against Hive, and Mack works alongside him at the Playground.
stages.whoA: The Air Force general working with S.H.I.E.L.D. against Hive.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he works with against Hive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Talbot comes back from Hydra still under its control and wins Mack's sympathy with an act. When he sends Hydra the Lighthouse's location and grabs Robin, Mack shoots him with an I.C.E.R., and later, as Graviton, Talbot turns on Mack and S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: A broken ally under Hydra's control, who becomes Graviton.
stages.whoB: The agent who falls for his act, then shoots him with an I.C.E.R.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Mack knows Andrew Garner as the friendly psychologist who assesses S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Inhumans. Meanwhile Lash, a monster hunting Inhumans, overpowers Mack again and again, until Mack and Lincoln find out that Lash is Garner.
stages.whoA: The friendly psychologist who turns out to be Lash, the Inhuman hunter.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who fights him and uncovers his secret.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hive, an ancient Inhuman wearing Ward's body, takes control of Daisy and turns her against Mack. Mack and Yo-Yo lure Hive into a trap that floods his mind with his hosts' worst memories.
stages.whoA: The ancient Inhuman who enslaves Daisy, whom he traps with a mind machine.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who traps him with a mind machine.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, leads the Watchdogs against Inhumans and S.H.I.E.L.D. Mack blasts his way into Ivanov's base, and Ivanov later blows up the oil platform while Mack is still trapped in the Framework.
stages.whoA: The Watchdogs' leader, who blows up the rig with him still inside.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who blasts his way into his base.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack hunts the ghostly Lucy Bauer as she goes after the Darkhold. At the prison where she seeks Eli Morrow, Mack and Robbie fight off her ghostly crew and free Morrow before she reaches his cell.
stages.whoA: A ghost hunting the Darkhold, whose crew he fights at a prison.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who reaches Eli Morrow before her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When Yo-Yo returns to S.H.I.E.L.D., General Talbot wants her on the Sokovia Accords list. She shows off her speed by stealing the medals off his uniform.
stages.whoA: The Air Force general whose medals she steals to prove her speed.
stages.whoB: The speedster who steals the medals off his uniform.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: When the Remorath attack the Lighthouse, Yo-Yo frees Talbot from his cell, and he greets her as Speedy. After he absorbs the gravitonium and becomes Graviton, he hurls S.H.I.E.L.D.'s cars and turns their bullets back on Yo-Yo and Mack.
stages.whoA: An old ally she frees, who becomes Graviton and turns on them.
stages.whoB: Speedy, who lets him out of his cell.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Yo-Yo breaks into Senator Nadeer's office to plant a camera, but Nadeer's guards are waiting and arrest her and Coulson. Nadeer uses the break-in to accuse S.H.I.E.L.D. of acting like Hydra.
stages.whoA: An anti-Inhuman senator whose office she breaks into.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman agent caught breaking into her office.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo, Skye's father, gathers a gang of gifted criminals to take revenge on S.H.I.E.L.D. Bobbi and Coulson track him to Coulson's old high school, where she fights his crew.
stages.whoA: Skye's father, whose gang of gifted criminals she fights.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who fights his gang.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Bobbi and May track Werner von Strucker, a young Hydra heir, hoping he will lead them to Ward. They burst in on Kebo torturing him in Lisbon, and Kebo stabs him before fleeing.
stages.whoA: A young Hydra heir she hunts to find Ward.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who tracks him to Lisbon.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln knocks Giyera down with a bolt of electricity when he tries to shoot Daisy at Hydra's castle. Giyera later ambushes him at the Transia building and knocks him to the floor.
stages.whoA: Hydra's telekinetic Inhuman, who ambushes him at Transia.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who shocks him down at Hydra's castle.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: James, the Inhuman called Hellfire, betrays Daisy and Simmons to the Watchdogs. Robbie rips his chain from him and fights him as Ghost Rider, then drags him out for S.H.I.E.L.D. to take into custody.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman who sells out Daisy, whom he beats as Ghost Rider.
stages.whoB: Ghost Rider, who beats him and hands him to S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Jarvis and Peggy investigate Calvin Chadwick, the Isodyne founder running for the Senate. Jarvis poses as a studio executive to get his wife alone and tails him from his campaign office.
stages.whoA: A Senate candidate he spies on with Peggy.
stages.whoB: A man posing as a studio executive who spies on him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sasha Demidov, the assassin in the green suit, ambushes Jarvis, Peggy and Leet Brannis on a milk truck full of bombs. Jarvis fires a shotgun at him as the truck races toward the water.
stages.whoA: The assassin in the green suit who ambushes him on a milk truck.
stages.whoB: A butler who fires a shotgun at him on the truck.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Posing as the Russian doctor Ivchenko, Johann Fennhoff takes over Chief Dooley's mind and has him lock Jarvis and Peggy in a room. He later kidnaps Howard Stark from Jarvis's side, and Jarvis takes to the air to stop the hypnotized Howard.
stages.whoA: A mind controller who kidnaps Howard and has him locked up.
stages.whoB: Howard Stark's butler, who flies out to stop his plan.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Helmut Zemo frames Bucky for the Vienna bombing to break the Avengers apart. Steve chases him to Siberia, where Zemo turns Tony against Steve and Bucky with the truth about Tony's parents.
stages.whoA: The man who frames Bucky and breaks the Avengers apart.
stages.whoB: The Avenger whose team he tears apart.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Wilfred Nagel is the scientist who remade the super soldier serum. Bucky, Sam and Zemo track him down in Madripoor and make him talk, and Zemo shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The scientist who remade the serum, tracked down in Madripoor.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, who comes with Zemo to question him.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Peggy fights Hydra with the S.S.R. as the Red Skull plans to strike America. When the Allies storm his last base, she and Phillips chase his plane down the runway in his own car so Steve can get aboard.
stages.whoA: Hydra's leader, whose plane she chases down the runway.
stages.whoB: An S.S.R. agent who storms his base and chases his plane.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Phillips leads the S.S.R.'s war on Hydra and sends Steve's commandos after the Red Skull. He leads the assault on Schmidt's last base, then chases his plane down the runway in Schmidt's own car.
stages.whoA: Hydra's leader, whose last base he storms.
stages.whoB: The colonel who leads the war on Hydra and storms his base.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In 1945, Dugan and Morita raid Hydra's last known base in Austria with Peggy Carter. They capture its general, Werner Reinhardt, who is later known as Daniel Whitehall, and Dugan puts him in handcuffs.
stages.whoA: Hydra general Werner Reinhardt, whom he handcuffs in 1945.
stages.whoB: A Howling Commando who handcuffs him in 1945.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In 1945, Morita and Dugan raid Hydra's last known base in Austria with Peggy Carter. Morita mocks the Hydra soldiers as they capture its general, Werner Reinhardt, along with the Obelisk.
stages.whoA: Hydra general Werner Reinhardt, captured in his 1945 raid.
stages.whoB: A Howling Commando who helps capture him in 1945.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Helmut Zemo frames Bucky to break the Avengers apart from within. In Siberia he shows Tony footage of Bucky killing his parents, and Tony turns on Steve and Bucky.
stages.whoA: The man who shows him that Bucky killed his parents.
stages.whoB: The Avenger he turns against Steve with the truth.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Tony hunts the Mandarin after the terrorist is blamed for the attack that nearly kills Happy. When he finally reaches him in Miami, he finds Trevor Slattery, an actor Killian hired to play a terrorist on television.
stages.whoA: The fake Mandarin, a hired actor he finds in Miami.
stages.whoB: Iron Man, who storms his Miami mansion.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: As the Iron Patriot, Rhodes hunts the Mandarin around the world. In Miami he finds only Trevor Slattery, a drunk actor, and threatens to break his face until Trevor gives up Killian and the Vice President.
stages.whoA: The fake Mandarin he hunts, who turns out to be an actor.
stages.whoB: The Iron Patriot who threatens him in Miami.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron crashes the Avengers' party at Avengers Tower while Rhodes is there. In Sokovia, Rhodes fights his robots and destroys the sentries attacking the lifeboats.
stages.whoA: Tony's rogue AI, whose robots he fights in Sokovia.
stages.whoB: War Machine, who destroys his robots over Sokovia.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Vice President Rodriguez backs Rhodes's rebranding as the Iron Patriot. When Rhodes warns him that Killian's men are after the President, Rodriguez, secretly in league with Killian, does not pass the warning on.
stages.whoA: The Vice President, who buries his warning to help Killian.
stages.whoB: The Iron Patriot, whose warning he buries.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: In Monaco, Ivan Vanko attacks Tony on the racetrack with electric whips. Happy drives the car into Vanko and pins him to the wall, then barely escapes as Vanko tears the car apart.
stages.whoA: A Russian with electric whips whom he rams with a car.
stages.whoB: Tony's driver, who rams him with a car in Monaco.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Happy tries to keep the scientist Aldrich Killian away from Tony in Bern in 1999. Years later he checks Killian's credentials at Stark Industries and spies on him and his bodyguard, which ends in the blast that nearly kills Happy.
stages.whoA: A scientist he distrusts, whose people nearly kill him.
stages.whoB: Tony's head of security, who spies on him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Coulson grows suspicious of Senator Nadeer and plans to bug her office. Her guards catch him and Yo-Yo breaking in, and Nadeer uses it to accuse S.H.I.E.L.D. of acting like a criminal group.
stages.whoA: An anti-Inhuman senator whose office he tries to bug.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent her guards catch in her office.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: James, the Inhuman called Hellfire, works with the Watchdogs to lure Inhumans to their deaths. Coulson, Mack and Ghost Rider raid his fireworks shop, rescue Daisy and Simmons, and take him into custody.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman working with the Watchdogs, whom he takes into custody.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who raids his shop and arrests him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Coulson and May go to a prison to protect Eli Morrow from the ghostly Lucy Bauer. She traps them inside and lets the prisoners loose on them, then makes off with Morrow.
stages.whoA: A ghost who traps him in a prison riot to take Eli Morrow.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she traps in a prison riot.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Coulson learns from Pepper that Obadiah Stane arranged Tony's kidnapping. When Coulson and his agents move to arrest Stane, he attacks them in his Iron Monger armor.
stages.whoA: Tony's partner, who attacks his agents in the Iron Monger armor.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who comes to arrest him.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: When Ultron's plan to wipe out humanity comes to light, Fury rallies the Avengers to outwit him. He brings a Helicarrier to Sokovia to evacuate its people and fights off a sentry that crashes into the control room.
stages.whoA: A rogue AI out to end humanity, whose attack he helps beat.
stages.whoB: The former director whose Helicarrier rescues Sokovia from him.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Jane, as the Mighty Thor, goes with Thor to Omnipotence City to ask Zeus for help against Gorr. Zeus refuses and tries to keep them there, so she fights his guards and helps take his thunderbolt.
stages.whoA: The king of the gods, who refuses to help and attacks them.
stages.whoB: The Mighty Thor, who fights his guards.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif follows Thor to Jotunheim, where Laufey, King of the Frost Giants, sends his warriors against them. She fights until they are outnumbered and Odin arrives to save them.
stages.whoA: King of the Frost Giants, whose warriors she fights on Jotunheim.
stages.whoB: An Asgardian warrior who fights his army on Jotunheim.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Judge Ravonna Renslayer of the TVA tries Loki for his crimes against the Sacred Timeline and sentences him to be reset, until Mobius steps in. She later turns against Loki and Mobius to protect the TVA's secrets.
stages.whoA: The TVA judge who sentences him, then turns on him.
stages.whoB: A Loki variant she sentences, then turns against.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: At the end of time, Loki and Sylvie meet He Who Remains, the man behind the TVA, who offers them his place. Loki fears what his death will unleash and tries to stop Sylvie, but she kills him.
stages.whoA: The man behind the TVA, who offers him his throne.
stages.whoB: A Loki variant who reaches him at the end of time.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: When the Temporal Loom begins to fail, Loki travels back to the Citadel to face He Who Remains again. He learns the Loom was built to fail, so Loki destroys it and takes the throne himself to hold the timelines together.
stages.whoA: The man behind the TVA, whose choice he rejects for his own.
stages.whoB: The Loki who refuses his choice and takes the throne.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: General Dox leads the TVA's hunters and wants every branched timeline pruned. When she and her loyalists set out to destroy the branches, Loki, Sylvie and Mobius sabotage the attack.
stages.whoA: The TVA general who wants every branch destroyed.
stages.whoB: A Loki variant who wrecks her attack on the branches.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter X-5 tries to prune Loki when he appears at the TVA, and Loki grabs his Time Stick. After X-5 deserts, Loki and Mobius track him down living as the actor Brad Wolfe and make him give up Dox's plan.
stages.whoA: A TVA hunter who tries to prune him, then runs off to act.
stages.whoB: A Loki variant who catches and questions him.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: When Gorr attacks New Asgard and takes its children, Korg fights his shadow monsters beside Thor. He then joins the quest to stop Gorr and get the children back.
stages.whoA: The god butcher, who takes New Asgard's children.
stages.whoB: Thor's Kronan friend, who fights his shadow monsters.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Thanos's snap wipes out Clint's whole family. When a past Thanos attacks the Avengers Compound, Clint fights his army and runs with the new Gauntlet to keep it from him.
stages.whoA: The Titan whose snap takes his family.
stages.whoB: An Avenger who fights his army and keeps the Gauntlet from him.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Natasha storms Hammer Industries to take down Ivan Vanko, but he flees before she reaches him. She then hacks his system and frees Rhodes's armor from his control.
stages.whoA: A Russian with a grudge against Tony, who flees before she arrives.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. spy who breaks his control of War Machine.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: S.W.O.R.D. rebuilds Vision's old body as a white Vision and sends it to Westview to destroy the Vision Wanda created. They fight until Vision restores his memories, and he flies away.
stages.whoA: His old body, rebuilt by S.W.O.R.D. and sent to destroy him.
stages.whoB: Wanda's Vision, who gives him back his memories.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rocket goes with Thor to forge a weapon that can kill Thanos and fights in Wakanda when Thanos comes for the Mind Stone. After the snap, Groot turns to dust in front of him.
stages.whoA: The Titan who wipes out half of all life, Groot with it.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who helps forge the axe meant to kill him.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket joins the Avengers to hunt Thanos down at his garden, only to find the Stones destroyed. He later fights a past Thanos and his army at the Avengers Compound.
stages.whoA: The Titan they hunt down, then fight again from the past.
stages.whoB: One of the Avengers who hunts him down at his garden.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: The Sovereign hire the Guardians to guard their batteries from the Abilisk, a giant tentacled beast. Rocket fights it with the others until Gamora kills it.
stages.whoA: A giant beast he fights over the Sovereign's batteries.
stages.whoB: One of the Guardians hired to kill it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and the Guardians fight their way onto Ronan's warship to stop him from destroying Xandar and confront him on the bridge. As the ship goes down, Groot wraps his friends in his branches and dies saving them.
stages.whoA: The Kree fanatic whose warship he fights to stop.
stages.whoB: One of the Guardians who confronts him on his ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Theel is one of the High Evolutionary's Recorders, carrying the code that can save Rocket's life. Groot and Quill tackle him off Arête, and Groot glides them down so Quill can take the code.
stages.whoA: The High Evolutionary's Recorder, who carries the code to save Rocket.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who carries him off Arête for the code.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Yondu agrees to help Quill board Ronan's warship and take the Orb from him. His Ravagers attack the Dark Aster over Xandar, and Ronan's forces shoot Yondu's ship down.
stages.whoA: The Kree fanatic whose warship his Ravagers attack.
stages.whoB: The Ravager leader whose crew attacks his ship.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Wilfred Nagel is the scientist who remade the super soldier serum. Sam, Bucky and Zemo track him down in Madripoor and question him, and Zemo shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The scientist who remade the serum, questioned in Madripoor.
stages.whoB: One of the men who corner him in Madripoor.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: In Madripoor, Sam poses as the gangster Conrad Mack to meet Selby, a crime boss who knows where Nagel is. When his sister calls him Sam on the phone, Selby sees through him and orders the three killed, before a sniper shoots her.
stages.whoA: A Madripoor crime boss who sees through his cover.
stages.whoB: A man posing as Conrad Mack, exposed by a phone call.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Scott escapes the Quantum Realm into the world Thanos's snap left behind and gives the Avengers the idea for the Time Heist. When a past Thanos attacks, Scott fights his army as a giant.
stages.whoA: The Titan whose snap he comes back to and helps undo.
stages.whoB: The Avenger who comes up with the plan to undo his snap.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Mitchell Carson, once S.H.I.E.L.D.'s head of defense and now with Hydra, comes to buy Darren Cross's Yellowjacket suit. Scott's break in at Pym Technologies wrecks the deal.
stages.whoA: A Hydra buyer whose Yellowjacket deal he ruins.
stages.whoB: Ant-Man, who wrecks the Yellowjacket sale.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Uzman, Sonny Burch's interrogator, spots Scott, Hope and Hank escaping the FBI and helps Burch chase them for Hank's lab. Scott takes down Burch's men, and Uzman is later caught and confesses.
stages.whoA: Sonny Burch's interrogator, who chases him for Hank's lab.
stages.whoB: Ant-Man, whose escape he reports to Burch.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Anitolov, one of Sonny Burch's henchmen, chases Scott and Hope across San Francisco for Hank's lab. He tries to shoot a giant Scott, who disarms him and punches their car.
stages.whoA: One of Sonny Burch's thugs, who shoots at him.
stages.whoB: Ant-Man, who disarms him at giant size.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: In the Quantum Realm, Janet takes Hope and Hank to Lord Krylar, her old friend and lover, for help. Krylar has sided with Kang and sells them out, and they have to fight their way out.
stages.whoA: Her mother's old lover, who sells them out to Kang.
stages.whoB: Janet's daughter, whom he betrays to Kang.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Anitolov is one of Sonny Burch's henchmen who hold Luis and the X-Cons hostage while Luis is dosed with truth serum. He later holds Luis at gunpoint until Dave and Kurt taser him, and he confesses to the police.
stages.whoA: One of Burch's thugs, who holds him at gunpoint.
stages.whoB: Scott's friend, whom he holds hostage.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox, one of Sonny Burch's enforcers, takes Luis, Dave and Kurt hostage at the X-Con office to make Luis talk. Later he chases Luis and Hope in the shrunken lab until his car runs off the road.
stages.whoA: One of Burch's enforcers, who holds him hostage and chases him.
stages.whoB: Scott's talkative friend, whom he holds hostage.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Uzman, Sonny Burch's interrogator, holds Dave, Luis and Kurt hostage at the X-Con office and doses Luis with truth serum. Later Dave and Kurt taser him to save Luis, and he confesses to the police.
stages.whoA: Burch's interrogator, who holds him hostage and whom he tasers.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Cons he holds hostage, who tasers him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Anitolov, one of Sonny Burch's henchmen, holds Dave and the X-Cons hostage at their office. Later Dave and Kurt taser him as he holds Luis at gunpoint.
stages.whoA: One of Burch's thugs, whom he tasers to save Luis.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Cons who tasers him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox, one of Sonny Burch's enforcers, takes Dave, Luis and Kurt hostage at the X-Con office to find out where Scott is.
stages.whoA: One of Burch's enforcers, who takes him hostage.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Cons he takes hostage.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Uzman, Sonny Burch's interrogator, holds Kurt, Luis and Dave hostage at the X-Con office and doses Luis with truth serum. Later Kurt and Dave taser him to save Luis, and he confesses to the police.
stages.whoA: Burch's interrogator, who holds him hostage and whom he tasers.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Cons he holds hostage, who tasers him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Anitolov, one of Sonny Burch's henchmen, holds Kurt and the X-Cons hostage at their office. Later Kurt and Dave taser him as he holds Luis at gunpoint.
stages.whoA: One of Burch's thugs, whom he tasers to save Luis.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Cons who tasers him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox, one of Sonny Burch's enforcers, takes Kurt, Luis and Dave hostage at the X-Con office to find out where Scott is.
stages.whoA: One of Burch's enforcers, who takes him hostage.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Cons he takes hostage.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos sends his army against Wakanda for the Mind Stone, and T'Challa leads the defense. When Thanos arrives, T'Challa charges at him and is thrown aside, then turns to dust in the snap.
stages.whoA: The Titan who invades Wakanda and turns him to dust.
stages.whoB: Wakanda's king, who leads the stand against him.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Ayo hunts Helmut Zemo for killing King T'Chaka, whom she failed to protect. She gives Bucky eight hours with him, and in the end the Dora Milaje take Zemo away to the Raft.
stages.whoA: The man who killed her king, whom she takes to the Raft.
stages.whoB: The Dora Milaje warrior who hunts him for T'Chaka.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When T'Challa goes to Busan to catch Ulysses Klaue, Shuri helps from her lab in Wakanda. She drives a car by remote to chase Klaue through the streets.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer she chases through Busan by remote.
stages.whoB: T'Challa's sister, who drives a car after him by remote.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Corvus Glaive returns with a past Thanos to attack the Avengers. In the battle, Okoye stabs and kills him with her spear.
stages.whoA: One of Thanos's Black Order, whom she kills with her spear.
stages.whoB: The Dora Milaje general who kills him.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor's warriors flood the Wakandan capital, and M'Baku leaps at him with his club. Namor breaks the club with his fist and knocks him aside.
stages.whoA: The king of Talokan, who breaks his club in the attack.
stages.whoB: The Jabari leader who attacks him from behind.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Phineas Mason, the Tinkerer, builds the Vulture crew's weapons from alien scrap. Peter overhears him and Shocker plotting at a gas station and spends the summer trying to stop the weapons he makes.
stages.whoA: The Vulture crew's weapons maker, building guns from alien scrap.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who keeps busting the deals for his weapons.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Boomerang, a costumed criminal, fights Spider-Man on a rooftop, hurling his boomerangs as Peter swings above the streets. Peter dodges them with ease.
stages.whoA: A costumed criminal who throws boomerangs at him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who dodges his boomerangs.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Ramrod, a hulking mercenary, charges at Spider-Man in a Manhattan alley in front of a crowd. Peter vaults over him and sends him head first into a brick wall.
stages.whoA: A hulking mercenary he sends head first into a wall.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who flips him into a brick wall.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Anton Miguel Rodriquez, the Tarantula, is a serum enhanced criminal Peter has been tracking. Spider-Man confronts him on a passenger boat near the Williamsburg Bridge and takes him in.
stages.whoA: The Tarantula, a criminal he catches on a passenger boat.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who catches him on a boat.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Miss Minutes goes rogue and sides with Ravonna Renslayer against the TVA, leaving B-15 to run it without its AI. B-15 battles their uprising, and when Miss Minutes is rebooted, B-15 still worries she could turn on them.
stages.whoA: The TVA's AI, who goes rogue with Renslayer.
stages.whoB: A TVA leader who fights her uprising and stays wary of her.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Zane, a Black Knife Cartel boss working for Kingpin, comes to Tamaha to take Maya. She fights through his men, but he holds Bonnie at gunpoint to force her to surrender, then leaves on a call from above.
stages.whoA: A cartel boss who comes to take her for Kingpin.
stages.whoB: The woman Kingpin's cartel hunts in Tamaha.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: When the Dweller-in-Darkness breaks free at Ta Lo, Xialing rides the Great Protector into battle against it. It drags her down before Shang-Chi destroys it with the Ten Rings.
stages.whoA: The soul-eating demon she fights on the Great Protector.
stages.whoB: Shang-Chi's sister, who fights it riding the Great Protector.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Agent Cleary of Damage Control sees footage of Kamala using her powers at AvengerCon and orders her brought in. When his agent Sadie Deever goes after Kamala and her friends at their school, he orders Deever to let them go.
stages.whoA: A Damage Control agent who orders her brought in.
stages.whoB: An enhanced teen he orders taken into custody.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Matt Murdock becomes the Parkers' lawyer and gets Damage Control's charges against Peter dropped, which ends Cleary's interrogations. Matt later sits beside Happy Hogan as Cleary questions him about missing Stark technology.
stages.whoA: The Damage Control agent he beats on Peter's case.
stages.whoB: The lawyer who gets his charges against Peter dropped.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Leland Owlsley manages the money for Wilson Fisk's operation. Matt tracks him down after his meeting with Nobu, pins him against his car and demands to know who he works for.
stages.whoA: Fisk's money man, whom he pins against a car.
stages.whoB: The masked man who attacks him by his car.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire goes with Danny and Colleen to China, where Madame Gao orders her men to kill Claire and Colleen. They take Gao prisoner, and Claire guards her and gives her truth serum while Gao needles her about wanting to be special like her gifted friends.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who orders her killed, then becomes her prisoner.
stages.whoB: A nurse who guards her and doses her with truth serum.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: During the hostage crisis at Harlem's Paradise, Shades corners Misty Knight with a gun. Claire hits him from behind and knocks him down with Misty, and later stomps on his sunglasses as he is led away.
stages.whoA: Diamondback's gunman, whom she takes down with Misty.
stages.whoB: The nurse who knocks him out and breaks his sunglasses.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Elektra, raised from the dead as the Hand's weapon, attacks Luke and the others at Midland Circle and again at the Royal Dragon. She kills Stick while Luke lies poisoned, and the Defenders finally beat her beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoA: A bulletproof man among the Defenders she fights.
stages.whoB: The Hand's weapon, whom he fights alongside the Defenders.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Jessica first meets Elektra when the assassin comes for John Raymond in her building. She later rams Elektra with a car at the Royal Dragon and fights her with the Defenders until they beat her.
stages.whoA: A strong private eye who rams her with a car.
stages.whoB: The Hand's assassin, whom she hits with a car.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Madame Gao is one of the Hand's leaders. When the Defenders storm Midland Circle, she matches Luke's strength with her chi and pins him to a wall with a car.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who matches his strength and pins him.
stages.whoB: A bulletproof hero she pins to a wall with a car.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra Reid leads the Hand and comes to the Royal Dragon to take Danny. Luke tells her that for all her talk of life, she kills a lot of people, and she later orders Elektra to kill him.
stages.whoA: The Hand's leader, who orders Elektra to kill him.
stages.whoB: One of the Defenders she orders Elektra to kill.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Murakami is one of the five leaders of the Hand. Colleen arrives at Midland Circle and helps the Defenders fight him, Gao and Bakuto in the final battle.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader she fights at Midland Circle.
stages.whoB: A swordswoman who helps the Defenders fight him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Harold Meachum, Danny's father's old partner, first tries to buy Colleen off through his son Ward. In the end he holds her at gunpoint at Rand Enterprises, and she helps Danny bring him down.
stages.whoA: Danny's foe, who tries to bribe her and holds her at gunpoint.
stages.whoB: Danny's ally who helps bring him down.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: John Pilgrim follows Madani to learn where Frank and Amy are, and she catches him and pulls her gun on him. He tells her to repent, and later she arrives by helicopter to stop him as he hunts Frank at a sheriff's station.
stages.whoA: A religious killer hunting Frank, who stalks her.
stages.whoB: A Homeland agent who catches him tailing her.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Wilson Fisk meets Chula at the post office and talks with her about loss. When he learns she is Maya's grandmother, he turns cold and takes her and Bonnie hostage to use against Maya.
stages.whoA: Maya's crime boss uncle, who takes her hostage.
stages.whoB: Maya's grandmother, whom he takes hostage.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Zane comes to Tamaha with the Black Knife Cartel to take Maya. He grabs Bonnie and holds a gun to her to make Maya surrender.
stages.whoA: A cartel boss who holds a gun to her.
stages.whoB: Maya's cousin, whom he holds at gunpoint.

May fights Hydra while Whitehall runs it and researches his past, but they never meet.
Fitz works missions against Quinn, but there is no confirmed exchange between them.
Fitz studies Lucy and guides the prison mission from the plane, but never faces her.
Fitz is not at Afterlife and never deals with Jiaying himself.
Mack fights her followers aboard the Iliad, but no scene between him and Jiaying is confirmed.
Hunter is attacking Ward's base while Werner is elsewhere; they never meet.
Trip guards Raina from Whitehall's men, but never meets Whitehall.
Hand runs the raids to rescue Coulson from Centipede, but never faces Raina.
Sousa investigates the case around Chadwick, but they never actually deal with each other.
Tony diverts the World Security Council's nuke, but never meets or speaks with Malick.
The wiki notes Kasius never meets Coulson in person.
Karja fights Drax, Mantis, Nebula and Quill on the Orgoscope; Gamora is not in that fight.
Knox guards Burch, holds the X-Cons hostage and chases Luis and Hope; he never faces Scott.
Luis helps with the heist on Cross's company, but never faces Cross.
Neither wiki page shows them meeting in Wakanda Forever.

Karen's upload exposes Hattley, but they never meet.
Foggy deals with Nadeem, not Hattley; they never meet.
Claire helps Danny and Colleen against Harold but has no confirmed exchange with him.
Claire is taken and held by the Russians' men; Anatoly himself never meets her.
Danny helps Luke against Bushmaster's people and lends him a hiding place, but never faces Bushmaster.
